Luraph v14.x deobfuscator v23

Completeness / large-script recovery:

- Fixes a bad fallback policy that could reduce a large devirtualized script to
  only the print()/warn() calls observed during tracing.
- A quick walk that converges with unresolved VM states no longer aborts the
  static lifter immediately. It escalates to a full salvage structuring pass.
- Salvage mode keeps recovered assignments, branches, loops, closures, calls,
  table accesses, and surrounding function structure around unresolved states.
- Removed the "static output is much larger than the trace" heuristic. A short
  behavior trace is not treated as a substitute for a richer static program.
- Compact trace-assisted reconstruction is now used only when the static result
  is genuinely insubstantial/broken or still Luraph bootstrap scaffolding.
- Alternate-root scanning also uses the same salvage mode when required.
- Existing v22 AncestryChanged/ChildRemoved/DescendantRemoving probe stripping
  remains enabled.

Important: an actually unsupported VM instruction is still emitted loudly as a
specific devirt error state rather than silently deleting the rest of the
program. This avoids convincing-looking but incomplete output.
